data.value:
SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱1,800,000 – ₱2,600,000 (Varies by trim and configuration)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,710 × 1,862 × 1,745 Wheelbase (mm): 2,706 Seating Capacity: 5–7 (depending on configuration)
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
2.5 L 4-Cylinder Gasoline
Maximum Output: ~181 hp Maximum Torque: ~245 Nm
Transmission: Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT) Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive (FWD) or All-Wheel Drive (AWD, depending on variant)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Approx. 1,600–2,000 kg (variant-dependent)
Payload Capacity: Approx. 500–600 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: 56 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 5–7
Infotainment: Touchscreen infotainment system (8”–9” depending on trim), smartphone connectivity
Speakers: 6 (standard), premium audio system on higher trims
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Disc / Disc
Suspension: MacPherson Strut front, Multi-Link rear
Tires / Wheels: 18” Alloy Wheels (standard), 20” Alloy Wheels on higher trims
Ground Clearance: Approx. 215 mm
